Story: As a staff member, I want to sign in with my mobile number and a PIN, so that my actions are recorded against my name.
As an owner, I want one permission model to drive both the menu and the API, so that what staff can see always matches what staff can do.
As a front desk receptionist, I want patient records to hide clinical details, so that I cannot open anything that is not mine to see.
As a clinic administrator, I want clinical fields removed from patient and queue lists, so that my access matches my role.
As a clinic owner, I want every sign-in, record open and payment logged, so that I can prove who did what.
As a clinic owner, I want shared tablets to lock when left unattended, so that patient data is never left open.
As a clinic owner, I want one person retrying to never lock out the rest of the clinic, so that the front desk always keeps working.
As a doctor, I want to take over a patient assigned to a colleague, so that I am never blocked mid-consultation.
As a salaried doctor, I want to see only my own patients and earnings, so that other doctors records stay private.
As a receptionist, I want to turn any tablet into a patient check-in kiosk, so that patients check in without queueing at my desk.
As a patient, I want to use the kiosk in my own language, so that I can check in without needing help.
As a patient, I want to confirm my mobile with a code, so that my check-in is linked to the right record.
As a patient, I want to enter my name, age, sex and allergies once at the kiosk, so that nobody has to type it again.
As a patient, I want to see the doctors who are actually in clinic now, so that I join the right queue.
As a patient, I want to see the fee and get a token before paying, so that I can queue now and pay at the desk.
As a patient, I want to check in by scanning a code with my phone, so that I do not have to touch the screen.
As a patient, I want the kiosk to keep what I typed if I pause, so that I do not have to start again.
As a patient using a screen reader, I want the kiosk fully operable without a mouse, so that I can check in independently.
As a patient, I want to book a doctor online without making an account, so that booking takes a minute.
As a clinic, I want the public booking API to reveal only my own clinic, so that other clinics data is never exposed.
As a patient, I want to link my health ID and see exactly what is shared, so that my records travel safely.
As a patient, I want to see my appointments, reports and dues on my phone, so that I stop calling the clinic.
As a receptionist, I want duplicate patient records flagged and mergeable, so that a patient does not end up with two histories.
As a doctor, I want my queue ordered by urgency and wait time, so that the sickest patient is seen first.
As a nurse, I want to record vitals once at the station, so that the doctor sees them without asking.
As a doctor, I want emergency and red-flag patients surfaced immediately, so that I do not miss a critical case.
As a nurse, I want to route a patient to the right doctor, so that they are seen by someone equipped for their problem.
As a doctor, I want the patient key facts before I type anything, so that I can start the consult in seconds.
As a doctor, I want one request for the whole clinical brief, so that the summary loads instantly.
As a doctor, I want a seven-step consultation form, so that I record a complete visit in one flow.
As a doctor, I want to tap examination findings by body system, so that I do not type during the consult.
As a doctor, I want to search and code my diagnosis, so that reports are accurate and billable.
As a doctor, I want to search any brand or salt, so that I prescribe what is actually stocked.
As a doctor, I want to be warned about allergies and drug interactions before signing, so that I cannot prescribe something harmful.
As a doctor, I want to order tests from the consultation, so that the lab gets the order without a phone call.
As a doctor, I want my common advice lines remembered, so that writing advice takes one tap.
As a doctor, I want to book the follow-up inside the consultation, so that the patient leaves with a date.
As a doctor, I want to save a repeated protocol and re-apply it, so that common visits take less typing.
As a doctor, I want to sign prescriptions digitally, so that they are legally valid and reach the patient instantly.
As a hospital or lab, I want records as standard FHIR data, so that any compliant system can read them.
As a doctor, I want referrals and colleague handovers in one inbox, so that nothing waiting on me is missed.
As a doctor, I want abnormal results flagged and filed to the visit, so that I act on them quickly.
As a doctor, I want to mark a no-show, so that my clinic no-show rate is accurate.
As a doctor, I want the consultation drafted from the conversation, so that I spend more time with the patient.
As a doctor, I want to issue a certificate from the patient record, so that I do not retype it.
As a doctor, I want to run a video consult that produces the same signed prescription, so that online patients get equal care.
As a receptionist, I want each finished consultation to arrive as a task list, so that I print, collect and book without re-typing.
As a receptionist, I want to take UPI, cash or card against an open bill, so that checkout is quick and the receipt is automatic.
As a clinic owner, I want GST-correct invoices with a reason for every discount, so that my books stand up.
As a receptionist, I want to refund a paid bill with a reason, so that the day totals stay correct.
As a receptionist, I want to close the day and be told if the cash does not match, so that I find mistakes before I leave.
As a receptionist, I want a day and week view I can check arrivals in from, so that I know who is coming.
As a patient, I want a text when my token is called and when my prescription is ready, so that I do not keep asking.
As a patient, I want my reminders, prescriptions and reports on WhatsApp, so that I receive them where I actually read them.
As a clinic owner, I want return-visit reminders and a waitlist, so that slots fill and no-shows fall.
As a clinic owner, I want to sell treatment packages paid in instalments, so that chronic patients stay with us.
As a clinic, I want to bill a TPA or corporate account separately from the patient, so that we can win corporate panels.
As a clinic owner, I want reports on money, patients and waiting times, so that I know how the day is going.
As a clinic owner, I want the app to tell me what needs attention, so that I act instead of reading dashboards.
As a clinic owner, I want to download everything about my clinic, so that I am never trapped if I leave.
As an owner, I want to add doctors by their government ID and set their fees and room, so that the system stays accurate.
As an owner, I want to see who has set their PIN and who has been active, so that access is always clean.
As an owner, I want to manage branches and rooms, so that a multi-branch clinic works from one place.
As an owner, I want to set my clinic details, letterhead and data location, so that documents are correct and I know where data lives.
As an owner, I want to see my plan, usage and limits, so that I know what I can grow into.
As an owner, I want to see every message sent to patients and why it failed, so that I can chase delivery.
As a new clinic, I want to be running on MedMate within ten minutes, so that I can start seeing patients.
As a clinic, I want the terms and data agreement to be final and accurate, so that my obligations are clear.
As a clinic owner, I want to export the activity log, so that I can answer a compliance question.
As a Kannada-speaking nurse, I want the station screens in my language, so that I can work without translating.
As a receptionist, I want to open the app straight to my desk, so that I do not choose my next action every time.
As a doctor, I want to find any patient from anywhere in one keystroke, so that I can retrieve a record instantly.
As a patient, I want to be told when my prescription is ready, so that I stop waiting in the clinic.
As a nurse on a slow tablet, I want the app to load fast, so that vitals are never delayed by waiting for pages.
As a doctor on the move, I want the station screens on my phone, so that I can consult away from the desk.
As a clinic, I want my data backed up and stored in India, so that records are safe and compliant.
As a product owner, I want to see which features are used and collect feedback in-app, so that I build what clinics need.
